name: Cart Empty
summary: Cart-specific resolved-empty profile that consumes canonical Empty State anatomy and one optional Button-styled recovery Link while the target owns cart truth, replacement, announcements, focus, copy, and destination.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Cart context hook layered on the required canonical Empty State ordinary grouping root; it adds no independent role, focus, live semantics, visual style, or interaction.

anatomy.name: emptyState
anatomy.description: Required canonical Empty State root that owns the passive centered composition and intrinsic content resilience.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional canonical decorative Empty State icon hidden from assistive technology because the visible title carries the meaning.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible cart-empty title using the canonical element-agnostic Empty State title class and a target-selected contextual heading element.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional canonical concise cart-specific recovery guidance omitted when blank.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: One optional native recovery Link with canonical Button presentation, rendered only when both label and destination are non-empty.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Single Cart Empty context profile of canonical Empty State without an independent visual variant.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Empty State responds to its actual container; K7 adds no public size.

states.name: resolved-empty
states.description: The target has authoritatively resolved that the cart has no line items and replaces the prior cart composition with this passive profile.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Cart Empty layers one domain hook on canonical Empty State and delegates all visual anatomy, content resilience, decorative-icon policy, and action presentation instead of duplicating them.

behavior.name: resolvedCartTruth
behavior.description: Only an authoritative target cart model may select this state. K7 does not infer emptiness from missing fixture content, fetch data, remove lines, or own cart state.

behavior.name: coherentRecoveryNavigation
behavior.description: The optional action renders as one native Link only when both non-empty actionLabel and href are supplied. K7 invents no fallback URL, command callback, disabled state, or additional action.

behavior.name: passiveSemantics
behavior.description: The static root is an ordinary group with no widget role, focus, live region, trap, or custom keyboard model. Heading rank remains target-context ownership through canonical Empty State.

behavior.name: targetOwnedTransition
behavior.description: When final-line removal creates this state, the parent cart coordinator atomically removes stale lines, totals, discount, and checkout controls and owns any qualifying localized Status announcement, focus recovery, history, and analytics.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Canonical logical sizing and wrapping preserve short, long, localized, bidirectional, unbroken, narrow-container, zoomed, forced-color, and token-mode content without K7-specific viewport rules.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional decorative icon mapped into canonical Empty State. It is hidden because required visible title text carries the state meaning.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty visible cart-empty title content; the target selects the appropriate contextual heading element.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional concise localized explanation or next step, omitted rather than rendered empty.

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: Optional non-empty localized recovery Link label; it renders only with a non-empty href.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Optional target-owned recovery destination; it renders only with a non-empty actionLabel and is never synthesized by K7.

accessibility: Render the required non-empty title in the contextual native heading selected by the host under ADR 0236; do not expose heading rank as a K7 property or visual control.
Keep the optional icon decorative and hidden because the visible title is text-complete; a meaningful illustration requires a different target-authored alternative-text contract.

Compose one native Link with a real target-owned href and canonical Button presentation only when both destination and descriptive label exist; preserve ordinary Tab, Enter, browser history, and modified activation.
Do not add role=status, aria-live, focus, tabindex, a landmark, or a custom keyboard model to every static Cart Empty root.
For a qualifying dynamic final-removal transition, use one pre-existing target Status owner with concise localized context and avoid duplicating the complete visible title.
Remove or hide stale lines, totals, discount fields, checkout controls, and their focusability as part of the same authoritative state transition.

Do not move focus merely to announce emptiness. The cart coordinator deliberately preserves focus, moves it to a surviving recovery destination, or restores it to the cart trigger according to the surrounding surface.

Preserve long/localized content, bidirectional isolation supplied by target strings, forced-color focus visibility, reduced motion, 200 percent zoom, and narrow-container containment through canonical dependencies.

web.notes: The `.cart-empty` context hook layers on canonical Empty State and one native Button-styled Link. K7 adds zero visual tokens and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Cart Empty snippet forwards required host heading_tag into canonical Empty State. Main cart selects H1 from Shopify cart truth with localized copy and `routes.all_products_collection_url`; live Ajax/drawer transition evidence remains target work.

react.notes: A parent cart store selects the canonical Empty State profile and owns replacement, status, focus, navigation, and analytics without local K7 state.

figma.notes: Map Cart Empty as an Empty State instance/profile with optional icon, message, and action presence; generic trace IDs are not K7 visual approval.

swiftui.notes: Native target maps required title, optional guidance/decorative visual, and one navigation action while the cart coordinator owns state and announcements.

compose.notes: Native target maps required title, optional guidance/decorative visual, and one navigation action while the cart coordinator owns state and announcements.
